_doc: Texture stage settings for tools/blender/gf_hero/s2_texture.py (shared) with Valdris's zones and painter (s2_valdris_paint.py). Metres, Blender axes.
_doc_zones: must equal s2_valdris_geom.ZONES (the material slot order of the parts)
_doc_bake_device: the RTX 4070 is shared with ComfyUI / game builds: every bake runs on the CPU (32 threads)

uv._doc_hidden_reach: the under-suit lies 4-8 cm under the plates: faces that find armour within 8.5 cm along their normal are packed at 0.3 density
uv._doc_hidden_start: the hidden-face probe starts 6 mm off the face: plates with pulled-in rims and raised gold bands have shallow concave creases whose own neighbours would otherwise count as cover

shading._doc: smooth = no sharp edges (organic); others get sharp edges above per_object_deg (default sharp_angle_deg)

hi_lo._doc: tangent normals + cavity + AO from the stage-1 sculpt reference (never shipped) onto the armour, beard and cape. valid_dist [full, none] (m): texels whose hit lies further than that from the low-poly surface fade to flat (the blockout's plates are not where this build's plates are everywhere); the tilt filter (normal_max_tilt_deg) drops the rest of the bad hits. The body under-suit and the face take no blockout detail (the blockout is armour there; its face is soft).

self_ao._doc: Cycles AO of the assembled low-poly parts (distance m)

paint._doc_declared: the turnaround sheet's colour script (the authority for the NPR base colours, brief section 4); palette.json's measured tones shade them

glow_regions._doc: anvil flanks (brief: the anvil's glowing cracks)
anvil gasket surroundings: the breastplate either side of the anvil's waist

scar._doc: cracked scar lines across the forehead and scalp (hero front), faintly ember (Reforged Flesh): a polyline in [azimuth, elevation] degrees around head_centre (azimuth 0 = the face, + = his left), radius = the skull's radius for the width

paint._doc_plate_lift_top: up-facing plate faces (what the 55-degree camera sees) lift this far toward stone.light

stone._doc: cracked stone-like gunmetal (the #2A242E family, declared.gunmetal is the plate base): light = the lit up-facing plane, edge = chipped edges and the lit block bevels, cavity = joints and inner corners; the anvil the same stone one value step lighter, its flat top the lightest face on him

tiles._doc: the stone-block mosaic (s2_valdris_paint.tiles): freq = blocks per metre (plate / anvil / lava crust), pnorm = the L_p metric (blocky cells), aspect = block width / height, warp (m) at warp_freq roughens the joints; gap / bevel / crack = half-widths (m); block_var = per-block value spread; crack_freq = the thin cracks across the blocks; edge_light = the chipped hard edges (edge bake); top_calm = how much calmer (block spread, bevels, joints) the up-facing planes are painted

veins._doc: the lava seams: iso-bands |fbm(seed) - 0.5| < width (+ region_boost x glow_regions) of a low-frequency field (freq per metre, one per seed) evaluated at each block's seed pick chains of blocks whose joints glow (half-width line, m) with white-hot dots at their corners (dot, m); broken into runs by an fbm gate (run, run_freq; + run_region inside the regions); base = the vein strength outside the glow regions; up_off = normal-z range over which the veins fade out on up-facing planes (the tops read clean from the game camera)

lava._doc: zone lava: dark crust plates (the tile mosaic at freq_lava) over glowing magma; gap = the glowing gap half-width (m); crust_glow = the dim glow through the crust

edge_bake._doc: baked by s2_valdris_paint.bake_extra inside the texture step (Cycles CPU): Bevel-node edge strength within radius (m) and pointiness; a second pass bakes ambient occlusion within joint_ao_distance (m) for the lava joints

junction._doc: lava in the plate joints (s2_valdris_paint.junction): where the short-range AO bake (edge_bake.joint_ao_distance) is occluded (jao range, 1 = open) an ember seam glows; fbm runs (run range at run_freq per metre) break it up; open = the parts' self-AO range over which it fades in (faces pressed flat on another plate stay dark); strength = the glow

paint._doc_gunmetal_warm: the plate base = the declared Gunmetal #2A242E mixed this far toward palette.json's measured plate base (#312C27): still the #2A242E family, less lavender under the toon shader's cool shadow band
